body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is silu output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k: 37.2 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e3m4, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 4 models with a format search (of 239 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 19.3 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 7.4 dB (stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae). 3 of 4 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (token agreement 100% → 43%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's), facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (token agreement 100% → 57%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's) and stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (token agreement 100% → 91%: the share of token positions whose predicted token matches full precision's).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): silu output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e3m4, 37.2 dB), linear output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e3m4, 37.6 dB), layernorm bias in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 37.8 dB), add output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 37.9 dB), linear bias in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e3m4, 39.3 dB), conv2d output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 40.6 dB), layernorm output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 40.6 dB), batchnorm output in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 40.7 dB), batchnorm bias in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 41.0 dB) and conv2d weight in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 41.1 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): mul outputs end furthest from full precision, facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 keeping only -3.8 dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, -3.8 dB), linear in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 4.5 dB), attention in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e3m4, 6.8 dB), conv2d in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 7.4 dB), linear in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 9.2 dB), silu in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.3 dB), groupnorm in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.6 dB), exp in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e3m4, 9.7 dB), silu in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 10.5 dB) and attention in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (fp8_e2m5, 11.1 dB).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e3m4 3518 (90%), fp8_e2m5 289 (7.37%), fp8_e1m6 114 (2.91%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 33 of 53 tensors passed between kernels (62%) in 1 model: 27 for attention heads split or merged, 3 for image patches and 3 for other reshapes.

The reading operations are 15 operations (15 calls, 7.81% of all calls; 201 M MACs, 10% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 27, conv2d → add (image patches) 3 and layernorm → conv2d (other reshapes) 3; most in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k (33).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 33 of 53 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations such as exp, GELU and reciprocal go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 64 operations in 1 model (64 calls, 33% of all calls), most often silu (34), layernorm (21) and attention (9). Their quantized accuracy: worst 10.5 dB SQNR over 64 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 22, most 22 (mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k, 22 planned groups), over 1 model.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 34.4 powers of ten for mul in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (largest value 1.48e+04).

Instruction memory (IMEM, 1,024 words per bank) use: not measured yet (no kernel built).
title: Resource limits: 64 operations limited by the LUT and up to 22 kernel launches per pass

body:
# IPU Architecture Costs — Summary (most costly first)

1. **Layout conversions (33 of 53 tensors, 62%)**: Most tensors passed between kernels must be rearranged by the reading kernel — 27 for attention head split/merge, 3 for image patches, 3 for other reshapes — affecting 15 operations (7.81% of calls, 10% of MACs) in mobilevit_s.cvnets_in1k, though extra cycles are not yet measured.

2. **Resource limits (64 operations via LUT)**: A third of all calls (33%) route through a 256-entry lookup table, limiting precision of silu, layernorm and attention; worst accuracy is 10.5 dB SQNR, and the pass requires up to 22 kernel launches (median 22).

3. **Accuracy loss on model outputs**: With NX8 formats, model outputs keep a median 19.3 dB SQNR vs full precision (worst 7.4 dB), and 3 of 4 models with a prediction metric lose accuracy — worst is stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae, dropping token agreement from 100% to 43%.

4. **Per-tensor and accumulated error**: The worst tensor in its best format is silu output in mobilevit_s (37.2 dB); along the data path, mul outputs end furthest from full precision (facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 at −3.8 dB), with fp8_e3m4 chosen for 90% of tensors.

5. **Not yet measured / no gaps**: MAC utilisation and IMEM use are unmeasured (no kernels built), no ISA workarounds or missing capabilities are needed, 0 links fail, and FP32 headroom is comfortable (least 34.4 powers of ten).
